name: Cloudflare Pages
free_limit: 500 builds/month on Free; 20,000 files/site, 25 MiB maximum per file and up to 100 custom domains/project
watch_out: One concurrent build per Free account; 20-minute build timeout. Pages Functions consume the separate Workers quota (100,000 Free requests/day with 10 ms CPU time each), not unlimited backend compute.
